Name: Get saplings from seedmaker
Author: SpaceSkirts
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=2]Are you tired of saving up thousands of gold so you can buy one little sapling at Pierres? Are you tired of seeing his smug face as he counts the gold you just spent while you sit and wait a [/size][i]whole [/i][size=2]season for your poor little tree to grow? If you said yes to either of those [/size][size=1](or you just want to make your own saplings)[/size][size=2], this mod is for you![/size]

[size=2]Now for the small price of 3 fruit, you can use the seed maker to break free of Pierres sapling monopoly.[/size][/font]

[b][font=Tahoma][color=#93c47d][size=4][u]What does this mod do?[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Tahoma][size=3]It's simple. Put 3 of any fruit tree fruit into the seed maker. Since it is a sapling, it will take 3 hours to process. Afterwards you may receive a sapling. There is a chance the seed maker will give you 2 saplings as well![/size][/font]

[b][font=Tahoma][color=#93c47d][size=4][u]Requirements[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Tahoma][size=3]Only Producer Framework Mod (PFM) is required. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]You can get it here[/url].[/size][/font]

[b][u][font=Tahoma][color=#93c47d][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/font][/u][/b]
[font=Tahoma][s]At the moment this is only for the vanilla fruits and fruit trees.[/s]
Version 1.5 adds compatibility with trees from other mods. [list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿*
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38413]Perfect fruit[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿
[/list][size=2]*apparently, Sunberry has its own way of crafting saplings so only the carob tree was included.
[/size][size=3]From what we tested, there are no incompatibility issues. If you do have any issues, please let me know.[/size]

[u][font=Tahoma][color=#93c47d][size=4]Credits
[/size][/color][/font][/u][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]Thank you so much to @[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Elorena0]Elorena0[/url] who helped me with the compatibility patches! 😊
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]And also, thanks to @Fakemonspriter for some of the suggestions.

[u][font=Tahoma][color=#93c47d][size=4]What's next?[/size][/color][/font][/u]
I am currently working on converting this mod over to Content Patcher. This is so I can better balance this mod, have better compatibility, and to fix a few minor compatibility bugs.
[/size][/font]
[i][font=Tahoma][size=2]Now go forth and fill your farm with trees![/size][/font][/i]
